fences.rule: How a represented alternative that does not occur changes the actual episode through a carrier is there; the organ that keeps the alternative live or wakeable without assuming incumbents cooperate is here.
fences.case: A rotated cadre maintaining parallel versions of active projects as if discarded alternatives had won, so current decisions stay compared against living paths not taken.

fences.rule: The carrier by which an erasure leaves a capacity standing, and who must witness it fall, is there; the scheduled protocol that performs the erasure so the organization can reuse what was abandoned is here.
fences.case: A protocol that strips personal authorship and branding from abandoned project files and extracts their templates into the design pool.
